contract.name: StakingPoolPlugin
contract.desc:
ARC-58 staking-pool plugin. Principal-resolution version (PHASE-0-SPEC §6.11): hinted target ABIs
with `windowHint(wallet)` (§3.8 rule 6), gate txns through `Gate.mustCheckFor(ctx)`, and per-pool
ABI selection by the child's `pv` marker. No method of this plugin changed its ABI.

returns.desc:
the mbr created for each boxmap entry. `entries` is the exact MBR of an entry stored
without gate args (Q14); a gated entry adds 400 µA per encoded gate-arg byte beyond the empty
array. Quote real entries with the pool's `enterCost`.
